page.layout: One printed page, centred text block with a running head at the top; no marginal notes in the text block. Blocks in reading order: running head with page number; continuing text (end of dedicatory letter) with place and date; date line in small capitals; centred heading "AUTHORES PRAECIPUI" with Greek-Latin subtitle and closing line; list of five authors; catchword "ELEMEN-" at lower right. Faint show-through from the reverse page appears in the margins and is omitted.

main_text.p: runt.Eò tibi cótendenti,ut Numinis ter maximi fauor aspiret, ex animo precor. Vale.Basileæ Heluetiorum, Idibus Aprilis, Anno Christiano M. D. LXXIX.
main_text.head: AVTHORES PRAECIPVI, qui huic Arithmeticæ μίρ᾽ ὧ ἐπιβάλλοντ᾽ contulerunt.

page.notes: Greek subtitle "μερ᾽ ὧν ἐπιβάλλοντ᾽" is hard to read on the scan; transcribed as best possible. The catchword "ELEMEN-" is set in spaced capitals at the right. The date line "M. D. LXXIX." is printed in small capitals. Show-through text from the facing page in the margins is not transcribed.
